card.name: Joins inside neuro-psychiatric terms
card.fires_on: Small joining marks or word parts partway through neurological and psychiatric terms, such as the slash in Impulse Control/Compulsive, the 've' in tardive, or 'malignant' before syndrome. Also the space or bracket after a section number or citation.

modes.label: Partway through condition names
modes.description: Inside or just before the end of a multi-part disorder name such as tardive dyskinesia or schizoaffective disorder.
